column1: # mapping_set_title: "India CERT-In SBOM & AIBOM Guidelines v2.0 <-> SPDX 3.1-dev"

# mapping_set_description: "Maps the 21 SBOM Data Fields and 19 AIBOM Elements defined in 'Technical Guidelines on SBOM | QBOM & CBOM | AIBOM | HBOM (Version 2.0)' (CERT-In, July 2025) to classes and properties in the SPDX 3.1-dev specification. The see_also column cites the neutral bridge concept from bom.ttl."

column8: comment
Element.name on a Package or Artifact element carries the component name.
Software.Package.packageVersion carries the component version string.
Element.summary or Element.description carries the component description.
Artifact.suppliedBy points to the Agent supplier of the software component.
Software.Package.concludedLicense carries the license governing the component.
Artifact.originatedBy identifies the origin/authoring agent of the software component.
Component dependency relationships are expressed via Relationship elements.
Security.Vulnerability elements and VulnerabilityAssessmentRelationship track component vulnerabilities.
Patch and remediation status is expressed via VulnerabilityAssessmentRelationship (e.g. fixedState).
Artifact.releaseTime specifies the official release date and time.
Artifact.endOfSupport records the end-of-life / end-of-support date.
No dedicated property in SPDX 3.1-dev; recorded via Element.comment or security assessment notes.
Recorded via Element.comment or license exception clauses in SPDX 3.1.
Artifact.verifiedUsing with Hash elements captures cryptographic checksums.
Element.comment carries free-text comments or notes.
CreationInfo.createdBy captures the agent(s) that authored the document.
CreationInfo.created is a mandatory xsd:dateTime recording when the SBOM was created.
Software.Package.primaryPurpose (set to executable/application) specifies executable nature.
Software.Package.primaryPurpose (set to archive) specifies archive property.
Software.Sbom structure indicates structured metadata format.
Software.Package.packageUrl carries the PURL unique identifier.
Element.name on an AI.AIPackage element carries the AI model name.
Software.Package.packageVersion on AIPackage carries the model version.
AI.AIPackage.modelType carries the model architecture/type classification.
Artifact.originatedBy specifies the developer or organization that authored the model.
Software.Package.concludedLicense on AIPackage carries the licensing terms.
Dependencies on software frameworks, libraries, and runtime tools are expressed via Relationship elements.
AI.AIPackage.hyperparameter and modelType capture ML model architectures and parameter details.
AI.AIPackage.metric (-> Metric) captures model evaluation metrics.
Dataset element properties and Artifact.originatedBy capture data source origin and provenance.
DataSets link between AIPackage and Dataset elements via TRAINED_ON / DEPENDS_ON Relationship elements.
Hardware element describes computing resources (GPUs, TPUs, accelerators) used for training/inference.
Encryption and access control security requirements documented via Element.comment or ExternalRef.
Input types partially covered by informationAboutApplication and typeOfModel. Narrow match; gap identified.
Output types partially covered by informationAboutApplication and typeOfModel. Narrow match; gap identified.
AI.AIPackage.domain specifies the intended application domain or target use cases.
Out-of-scope or prohibited usage scenarios recorded via Element.comment or model card documentation.
AI.AIPackage.energyConsumption captures energy use, resource footprint, and carbon impact.
Security.Vulnerability elements track known security issues in the AI model and dependencies.
Digital signatures and integrity attestations recorded via verifiedUsing with Hash or external signature bundle.
